name: Camp Lochearn for Girls
description_short: An overnight summer camp for girls ages 7 to 15 on Lake Fairlee in Post Mills, Vermont, founded in 1916. It offers two full sessions of about three and a half weeks, plus shorter "Middler" sessions of about two weeks for girls who have finished 4th grade or younger.
refund_policy_summary: Payment terms: $2,500 deposit with application, $2,500 due by February 1, balance due by April 1. The page states no refund policy.

sources.note: 2027 dates and tuition. $10,200 is shown once under the two full sessions; read as per session (the two-week Middler sessions are $6,225).
Activities summary: girls overnight camp for ages 7-15; the FAQ's divisions (7-10, 11-12, 13-15) agree

source.title: Dates & Fees  | Camp Lochearn for Girls

warnings: It is not clear whether the $10,200 tuition is per session; it appears once below both full sessions. This listing assumes it is per session.
Middler sessions are only for campers who have finished 4th grade or younger. This applies only to the Middler sessions, not the whole camp.
Riding costs extra: Every Day $1,850, Every Other Day $1,200; Middler Every Other Day $850. These amounts are not included in session prices.
Transportation costs extra and 'varies by location'.
